backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing user profile management, role-based access control, signup with access code, and admin-only user operations.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files covering styles, config, hooks, components, pages, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles with OKLCH color tokens for light/dark themes and global UI variables.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the SPA and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up router, authentication flow, profile gating, and admin-protected routes for the frontend app.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays a restricted-access message with a button to return home for unauthorized users.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with navigation, role‑based admin Users link, and logout handling tied to Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Application scaffold providing header, content wrapper, and footer with branding attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Internet Identity login screen with loading states and guidance for new users.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Signup form validating user details and access code, then submitting sanitized profile to backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the user's Internet Identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and helpers for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines react-query hooks for user profiles, user management, and service report CRUD operations using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables and global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin page that lists users, checks admin permissions, and allows deleting users with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report, handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form page for creating a daily service report with validation, state management, and submission via useCreateReport.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Displays a searchable, filterable list of service reports with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Validation helpers for signup fields including required checks, email, mobile number, and admin access code.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters used in routing and state retention.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking feature requests for backend authorization and data integrity improvements.
